authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan sources, focusing on underetymologised and smaller sources first for greater diversity. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have unlimited time now

proposals.evidence: Turner2245 gives regional biś-/beś- sit forms and explains initial b through early MIA *uba-, while retaining possible contamination with vasati. Grangali bis is the s-stem rather than the ṭṭh past-derived stem; that broader historical uncertainty is retained. Existing manual source collation reports Material_Error=no; no transcription or identity repair.

proposals.evidence: Turner6250 gives Shumashti dāṛi and regional Pashai dāṛī, Wotapuri deāṛ and Gawri dāṛī beard through the dāṭhikā/dāḍhiā family. Grangali darī agrees with that regional family. Preserve the source plain r, accent and unmarked initial length. Turner’s deeper fang/tusk/beard reconstruction and possible substrate influence remain uncertain. Existing manual source collation reports Material_Error=no; no transcription or identity repair.
